summary: Srinivasan describes AI as many human-prompted models and expects it to decentralize. He warns about fakes, eroding trust and Chinese AI dominance.

statements.quote: AI, like every technology, has both costs and benefits. It’s going to create a lot of wealth (already has), but it’s also going to create a lot of costs.
It’s possible technology changes this. But right now, AI agents aren’t truly autonomous. They are built for the prompt, bots on a leash.
The problem is one of Chinese AI domination, rather than AI doom. The solution is likely Internet AI decentralization, again rather than AI doom.
In short, AI may radically increase productivity within tribes but also radically reduce trust between tribes. Costs for verification, proctoring, and vetting are soaring.
We have many models from many factions that have all converged on similar capabilities, rather than a huge lead between the best model and the rest.
statements.venue: Essay, AI is polytheistic, not monotheistic
